ns2:course.label: Asian American Psychology
ns2:course.description: Examines central themes in the psychological study of Asian Americans such as race, ethnicity and culture, family issues, gender and sexuality, stereotype and discrimination, mental health and counseling, and public policy; analysis of historical, sociological, political, cultural, local, and global backdrops for the individual psychological experiences. Same as AAS 470. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PSYC 100 or consent of instructor.
